about: The fixed views every look step is judged on. Camera at eye, aimed at look, field of view fov, game clock in hours. Same shots, same order, every time. Measured in the built world on 11/26/2026: lake water spans x -116..104 and z -135..25 at y 10, ground top is y 11, the dock runs from the south shore north at x -6 (z 25 to -21), the stands and home pond sit south of the dock (z 42 to 50). Cedar Creek runs north to south along x -236 (riffle z -25..20, deep pool z -125..-65), entered through the gate at x -168.
